purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for HSR Level 4 (30.5 m) — Split 90° Left from Single-Track One-Way Mainline — Compact.
name: HSR Level 4 (30.5 m) — Split 90° Left from Single-Track One-Way Mainline — Compact
description: A left-hand split or merge on the centered one-way 30.5 m track. No opposing mainline track is crossed. Use matching one-way L4 fillers and level adapters. The L4 mainline and branch are both one-way single tracks.

provenance.geometry: NAM HSR/GHSR native texture and profile with SCP authored geometry.
provenance.construction: SCP directed Monorail PATHs and independent fixed-piece rules.

design_review.summary: Closely spaced pillars need a support-consolidation review.
reasons: Separate 1.3 m-square pillar foundations have centres less than 2.6 m apart near shared rail geometry. The foundations do not overlap, but the close pair should be reviewed and consolidated to address the reported duplicate-pillar appearance. The 2.6 m review cutoff is an authoring convention, not a structural or game collision threshold.
